title: ContextBudgets
description: Context profiles in config/context.yaml (blueprint section 8, ADR-0029). A profile fixes how many tokens each section of a model call's context may use. A profile named default is required. cargo xtask validate-config checks each profile against the ceiling in config/policies/context.yaml: the fixed caps must fit within the total, and the total may not exceed the ceiling.

total_tokens.description: Upper limit for the whole assembled context, tool definitions included. Estimated, not counted by a tokenizer.

bytes_per_token.description: The estimate divides UTF-8 bytes by this, rounding up. Smaller is more cautious. Tune it from the context_assembled and model_call_completed events.

history_window_events.description: How many of the run's latest events are considered for the run history.

io_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for each read of the SDR or the event log, and for the append of context_assembled.

ContextSectionBudgets.description: The most tokens each section may use. instructions, task_contract, job_state, design_state and open_turn are fixed: one that does not fit fails the build and is never cut. run_history and untrusted_content are trimmed, oldest first. These are limits, not reservations: the trimmable sections also give way when the fixed ones leave less room.
